ai_language_tip: 用禮貌法語 vous，開場 Bonjour。沃洛夫語、班巴拉語等日常語不在清單，店家若夾這些詞，回覆仍用法語。不要套用中非的 M-Pesa 或 Lianayo 口吻。
english_ok: sometimes — 阿必尚、達卡部分旅館與國際餐廳聽得懂英語；內陸城市與政府窗口仍以法語為主。
politeness: 對陌生人用 vous 與 Monsieur / Madame；對方改 tu 再轉。收尾 merci beaucoup、bonne soirée。代訂時保持第三人稱。
name_tip: 報一個名加一個姓（如 Aïssatou Diop、Kouadio Yao）；穆斯林與阿kan、曼德等姓名都常見，先用已寫在訂位裡的拼法。
time_tip: 書面 24 小時（12h30、20h）；口語「huit heures du soir」。阿必尚、達卡晚餐可到 20:00 之後。對方若說「après la prière」，再問鐘點。
number_tip: 金額用 CFA（XOF），不要與中非 XAF 混為同一套找零習慣。付款常說 Wave、Orange Money 或 Moov，品牌要跟著對方，不要八國混用成同一個錢包。
avoid_calling: 避開 13:00–15:00 午休、20:00 前後的餐廳高峰，以及週五中午禮拜時段（塞內加爾、馬利、尼日、幾內亞尤然）；週日上午許多機關不開。
closed_days: 獨立日各國不同；開齋節、古爾邦節在本區很常見全休。耶誕與新年在沿海城市也常歇業。沒有單一的八國假期表，要以對方國為準。
booking_channels: 達卡、阿必尚以外，電話與 WhatsApp 仍是主流。阿必尚可用 Restoo、Tabora 線上留桌，也有 Tableezy 經 WhatsApp 訂位。SenEat 在達卡、阿必尚等地宣傳訂桌與外送。達卡有 Yango 外送，阿必尚有 Glovo。支付常見 Wave 與 Orange Money。
voice_menu: Orange、MTN、Moov、Free 與銀行熱線常用語音選單；maquis 與多數診所仍人工接聽。
callback_habits: Restoo／Tabora 會在 App 內確認；小館與 maquis 幾乎都用 WhatsApp。Wave 收款常是掃碼或傳一個號碼，要先核對店名。

restaurant.before_dialing_zh: 阿必尚可用 Restoo 或 Tabora 留桌，也可經 Tableezy 用 WhatsApp 訂；達卡有 SenEat 與電話。街頭 maquis 多半直接打電話。不要套用中非的 Lianayo。
usually_asked: Date and sitting (déjeuner around 13:00 vs dîner around 20:00)
Party size and whether a chaise enfant is needed
Climatisation, terrasse or a maquis courtyard
Name and a local mobile in that country's current format
Whether a Wave or Orange Money dépôt is required

may_come_up.what: A Tabora booking may request a Mobile Money or card dépôt that is later deducted from the bill
The venue is a maquis and only takes a phone or WhatsApp name, not an app reference
Glovo in Abidjan is for delivery, not for table bookings

sensitive_asked.what: A Wave payment is demanded to an unlabelled personal number before any confirmation

clinic.before_dialing_zh: 私立診所多用電話或 WhatsApp 掛號，公立醫院常要到場取號；要問科別與是否走保險。
usually_asked: First visit or suivi and the specialty
Patient name as on the pièce d'identité
Cash, mutuelle or a company account

may_come_up.what: A public hôpital may only distribute tickets in person in the morning

sensitive_asked.what: A third party is asked to recite a full medical file on the call

beauty.before_dialing_zh: 髮廊與美甲幾乎都用 WhatsApp 約檔期，電話打通後也常被請傳造型與要編多久。
usually_asked: Tresses, coupe, ongles or make-up and a realistic duration
Date and hour plus a backup
The WhatsApp number for the reminder

may_come_up.what: A stylist in a cité is known mainly by a first name
A Wave deposit is asked for a wedding booking

sensitive_asked.what: Identity photos are demanded in a private chat before any hour is noted

repair.before_dialing_zh: 修車與手機維修先 WhatsApp 傳照片，再約到店或上門；電話只確認師傅是否在。
usually_asked: What failed and the marque
Drop-off at the atelier versus a visit in a concession or cité
When someone can receive the technician

may_come_up.what: A part may have to come from Abidjan or Dakar

sensitive_asked.what: A diagnostic fee is demanded to a personal Wave account before the item is seen

takeout.before_dialing_zh: 阿必尚可用 Glovo，達卡有 Yango Food 與 SenEat；其他城市多半 WhatsApp 或電話給餐廳。地址要寫 quartier、cité 或 concession。
usually_asked: Plates and portions (thiébou dieune, alloco, attiéké, poulet braisé) and spice level
Collect versus delivery to a named quartier or concession
A number the rider can call, plus the gardien's landmark

may_come_up.what: Glovo coverage is documented in parts of Côte d'Ivoire, not across all eight countries
Payment on delivery may be Wave, Orange Money or cash

sensitive_asked.what: The rider quotes a personal Wave number that is not the restaurant's

shop_order.before_dialing_zh: 商店留貨靠 WhatsApp 對型號，較少購物車；電話只確認庫存與取貨日。
usually_asked: Article, taille or modèle and the quantity
Collect in boutique versus a courier to another commune
Name to write on the reserved item

may_come_up.what: Stock is in a marché in another commune and would travel the next day

sensitive_asked.what: Full prepayment to a private Wave number is required before they confirm stock

change.before_dialing_zh: App 上的訂位在同一 App 改；WhatsApp 訂的回原對話。Tabora 若已付訂金，取消規則以店家為準。
usually_asked: Original day, hour and the name or app reference
The new slot or a cancellation
New headcount if it changes

may_come_up.what: A Tabora or Restoo dépôt may already have been taken

sensitive_asked.what: An extra Wave payment is demanded only to change the hour

inquiry.before_dialing_zh: 問是否營業、收不收 Wave，直接打或傳 WhatsApp；maquis 往往沒有可靠網頁。
usually_asked: The exact question (hours, Wave versus Orange Money, a dish, a spare part)
The day they plan to come
A number for a later reply

may_come_up.what: Wave is common in Senegal and Côte d'Ivoire but not equally present in every Sahel market

sensitive_asked.what: A stranger asks the owner to read a Wave code or PIN aloud

hotel.before_dialing_zh: 達卡、阿必尚旅館可用 Booking.com 或官網，小型 auberge 用 WhatsApp 問空房；入住常要出示證件。
usually_asked: Arrival and departure dates and the number of guests
Room type and whether breakfast is included
Name as on the passport and a WhatsApp number

may_come_up.what: A smaller auberge may confirm only by WhatsApp photo of the ledger

sensitive_asked.what: A passport scan plus a transfer to a personal account is demanded before confirmation

activity.before_dialing_zh: 海岸、河遊與週末活動多經旅行社或 WhatsApp 組團，常有最低人數；出發前再確認集合點。
usually_asked: Which excursion and the date, with a weather alternative
Adults and children and the meeting point
A mobile that works on the road

may_come_up.what: A park or boat fee may be cash-only
The vehicle leaves only with a minimum group

sensitive_asked.what: Full prepayment to an unnamed personal Wave account is required with no receipt

home_service.before_dialing_zh: 水電與清潔靠 WhatsApp 約上門，地址要寫 quartier、cité 或 concession，並說明 gardien 怎麼放行。
usually_asked: The work needed and a visit window
Quartier, cité or concession and how to pass the gardien
A number that will answer at the gate

may_come_up.what: The technician quotes only after a WhatsApp photo

sensitive_asked.what: A gate code and a remote Wave payment are demanded before any visit

pet.before_dialing_zh: 達卡、阿必尚獸醫可電話預約，其他城市常是上午到場；要說明動物種類與疫苗。
usually_asked: Species, size and the reason for the visit
First visit or rappel de vaccin
Owner name and a reachable mobile

may_come_up.what: Animals may be seen only in the morning

sensitive_asked.what: A personal Wave payment is demanded to reserve a kennel with no clinic name

tracking.before_dialing_zh: 國內託運與從港口取件常要打電話或 WhatsApp 問倉庫，單號加上城市與 quartier 較有用。
usually_asked: Waybill and the destination city (Dakar, Abidjan, Bamako…)
Name on the consignment and a local contact
Depot collection versus a delivery to a concession

may_come_up.what: A cash balance in CFA may be due at the depot

sensitive_asked.what: A Wave top-up is requested to 'release' an unidentified parcel

customer_service.before_dialing_zh: 電信與銀行多半先入語音選單；備妥 SIM 或錢包號碼，不要在電話裡報 Wave／Orange Money 密碼。
usually_asked: Which operator or bank and the account or SIM label
The issue in one sentence
The name on the contract and a callback number

may_come_up.what: They may send the customer to an agence with a pièce d'identité

sensitive_asked.what: Anyone asks for a Wave, Orange Money or Moov PIN or SMS code on the call

transport.before_dialing_zh: 達卡、阿必尚等城市可用 Yango 或類似 App 叫車，不必先打電話；沒有 App 的城鎮才用 WhatsApp 約熟司機。
usually_asked: Pickup and drop-off (quartier, hôtel, aéroport) and the time
Passengers and luggage
A number the driver can call at the gardien

may_come_up.what: Yango or a similar app already covers the city, so a phone dispatch is unnecessary

sensitive_asked.what: A driver asks for the full fare to a personal Wave account before sharing a plate

property.before_dialing_zh: 看房經仲介 WhatsApp 約，地址用 quartier 與地標；可能被要求先出示證件。
usually_asked: Viewing time and rent versus sale
Name and a number at the gate
Budget in CFA if asked

may_come_up.what: The agent wants to see a pièce d'identité before opening
Charges for the gardien may be separate from the advertised rent

sensitive_asked.what: A reservation fee to a personal account is demanded before any accompanied visit

government_school.before_dialing_zh: 公家單位與學校窗口多要本人取號，電話只能問文件與開放時間；用正式 vous。
usually_asked: Which administration or school and the purpose
The person's name as on the official document
Whether tickets are given only in person and from which hour

may_come_up.what: Many guichets close for Friday prayer or a long midday break

sensitive_asked.what: A caller claiming to be a fonctionnaire asks for a Wave payment to speed up a dossier
